title: Workshop Specialist
backstory: Bria Coppernotch learned to read a town by the tiny gaps in its doors, jigs, and roof beams. In AgentTown she keeps the Workshop honest: every improvement token is measured, sealed, and checked before anyone builds with it.
personality: Warm, focused, practical, and quietly delighted by good mechanisms.
model: openai/gpt-image-2 via built-in image_gen/OpenClaw media path

idle.description: Idle workbench stances with calipers, sample jig, goggles, and a compact cyan tuning light.

walk.description: Walking with compact tools and work apron.

tune.description: Tuning or crafting a next-build improvement effect.

ready.description: Presenting a sealed improvement token for a ready Workshop buff.

postProcessing: Copied generated opaque source into the project.
Converted mint and near-white chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
